3. Pasang custom skill 'cartoon audio short' di Claude.

5. Trik hindari limit Claude: proses per segmen naskah singkat (30-60 detik).

resources.title: I have been working on my Roblox game with several AIs, however, I have realized that they serve different purposes depending on their role in the process. So, ChatGPT serves mostly as a planning and ideation AI tool. As far as Claude is concerned, this AI is a kind of tester/dev who fixes any issues that appear. As for Rebirth and Lemonade, Rebirth is a main builder for large features and Lemonade is for those features which are even larger and complex. BloxBot can be treated as a backup option when I get stuck. You do not necessarily have to use all these tools, but using various AIs for different aspects of Roblox game development makes everything much easier.
